title: Whisperer kaŋŋe e nder ladde
intro: Natal hoɗorde jeereende mawnde e nder wakkati daɗndo e ŋakkeende hoolaare. Ardiiɗo mawɗo yahi ngam hawritde e Diine, acci renndo ngo ina yiɗi huunde teskinnde ngam jogaade. E nder oon fooftere nde alaa ɗo haaɗi, limre muñnde ina yahra yeeso e fodoore jalbooje e tagoore ƴoƴnde nanndunde e nguurndam.
clues: Miɗo jeyaa e yaltuɓe Misra e Muusaa, miɗo seedtoo maayo feccii ngam dogde men.
Miɗo ndaara nde gardiiɗo amen yahi to dow tulde jammaaji capanɗe tati ngam heɓde ardorde.
Mi mooftii paabi e yimɓe ɓee, mi mbayli ɗi e juuɗe am.
Mi fawi nagge ngee ina hokka daande ɓuuɓnde, mi noddi yimɓe ɓee e mayre.
Mi ƴettii junngo e ɓuuɓri e laawol nulaaɗo, mi werlii ɗum e ko mbaɗmi koo.
Mi fotndi e Muusaa, mi ñaawii mi wiyde ‘to meem am’, mi wuura seertude, e batu fodanoongu ñaawoore.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
